summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing a Share Purchase Agreement for a registered direct offering of up to 665,000 Class A ordinary shares at $3.00 per share, or roughly $2.0 million gross, to a single named investor. The shares are sold off an existing Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-292982) declared effective February 9, 2026, via prospectus supplement. Closing follows Rule 15c6-1 timing, with payment by wire or USDT and delivery via DTC DRS; best-efforts, self-underwritten. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing versus market and any future dilution overhang.
